summary: Retest of the iteration_53 items, run on the public URL. ALL PASS. (1) The quota labels in dados-inscricao and confirmacao (.conf-flags, c-negros, c-pcd) now say 'prevista(s) no Edital nº 1 – SEFAZ/AL para pessoas negras / com deficiência'. (3) Panel candidate modal: the section is now 'CONCURSO / CARGO', with no 'É militar?' and no 'Ensino médio'. The bundle main.fda9cfa5.js?v=sefaz2 has no eh_militar or Ensino médio. (4) 'Desenvolvido por' / DesenvolvimentoProSeleta markup is gone from all 5 flow pages. Only CSS rules for internal classes remain, which do not count. (5) POST /api/track/registration with finalized=true and no edital saves edital SEFAZ_AL_26. (6) Full UI regression passed: inicio -> termos -> inscricao (CPF 529.982.247-25, RG front/back, delivered@resend.dev) -> dados-inscricao (AFTE, MACEIÓ/AL, cota negros) -> confirmacao -> inscricao-realizada (R$ 300,00). The DB record has edital SEFAZ_AL_26, concurso 'SEFAZ/AL 2026 - Cebraspe' and valor 300. No VUNESP/SEDUC/Ceará/Polo/Ensino médio/militar text on any flow page or on the panel dashboard, inscricoes, cadastro or modal. The test inscription and cadastro (CPF 52998224725) were deleted afterwards.
